hostDifferences.difference: The tools a project can recommend are this machine's: Web search and Research when the running core can search (chat-tools-model.mjs searchSupport), Extended thinking (which _e skips), and the customize connectors (MCP servers); no claude.ai org features, first-party integrations or directory servers.

The conversation the strip switches is the project page's New chat (config.chatTools defaults through main.cjs "chat-tools" set), a connector's tools are its customize MCP server switch; no claude.ai connect flow (a disconnected connector opens nothing).

The conversation menu (Ff's items for a project page row: Pin / Unpin, Rename, Delete, with their p / r / d keys) acts on the local session (main.jsx sessionAction pin / unpin, the sliced Rename chat dialog, the host Delete chat confirmation); its project, artifact, archive and read-state items (claude.ai services or props this caller does not pass) and the right-click variant are not offered.
Renaming a chat renames the local session (main.jsx sessionAction rename) instead of PUTting the claude.ai conversation.
No Statsig dynamic configs: claude_ai_haystack_integrations answers its fallback ([]), so the tools view lists no first-party integrations.
The zod schema je hands the dynamic config hook is never consulted (no dynamic configs): an inert schema.
The zod schema je hands the dynamic config hook is never consulted (no dynamic configs): an inert schema.
A connector's favicon is looked up through a remote favicon service; this host makes no such request (E59), so the official fallback (the letter avatar Ee passes) renders.

The example-project tooltip (and the project-limit upsell it can open, shared-3 UR over the lazy ca3e55b0e chunk) wraps the Example project badge, which only a claude.ai starter project shows; a local project never is one, so the badge renders as is.
The extension-to-MIME table chunk (c911e1a3d) is not loaded: it only refines `accept` filtering, and the project drop zone accepts any file (main converts or refuses each one).
The memory dialog's open state lives in the project page instead of the ?modal=memory search parameter (the host has no URL router).
Memory is available when this machine's local memory (electron/chat-memory.mjs, Settings > Memory) is on and not paused.
The project's "Manage memory" dialog is the host one (source-settings-memory.jsx MemoryManageDialog, the c274117ff O layout) over the local project memory (chat-memory controls with projectId).

The "profile instructions" link (/settings/general) opens the host Settings page holding the profile (global) instructions, Settings > Instructions (bm.instructions; the host page id "instructions"): the click is prevented, so the window never navigates to a claude.ai route.
Pictogram defs are bundled on the host (source-pictogram.jsx) instead of the lazy pictogram_def_loaders chunk, so there is no empty placeholder frame or fade-in.

A cowork session filed in a local project is a row of the official row layout (c75e89812 jo) with its title ("Local task" when untitled) and relative date; no live status dot, review popover, files strip, inline approval or session menu (those read the claude.ai session stores).
A cowork row's link is the router link alone, without yl's session context menu (claude.ai archive / rename / delete services).
No subtitle or share descriptor: Tu returns { subTitle: null } when raven (team plan) is off, which it is without an account.
The project share modal chunk (c8d15a635) is not loaded: the share button it serves needs raven.
The share-link dialog is not rendered: it opens only from the Share button, which needs an account.

Integrations (haystack: the shared-78 org feature under the GrowthBook haystack_enabled gate) are off, as without an account (E49/E69), so the recommended tools strip (c9b54eb90 De) renders nothing; its model stays (one constant turns it on).
The team-only "Resynthesize memory" button stays hidden: its GrowthBook flag (claudeai_saffron_frontend.resynthesize_enabled, default false) is off here (D29/D31).
No claude.ai memory synthesis endpoint: the button that calls it is hidden (resynthesize_enabled off).
The project memory ({memory, updated_at}) is read from the local memory store (<userData>/memory/projects/<id>.md, chat-memory state with projectId) instead of /api/organizations/<org>/memory.
No claude.ai project queries to invalidate or remove: the local project record is updated only when the save succeeds.
The pin toggle, the instructions and the recommended tools write the local project (local-projects update isStarred / instructions / settings) instead of PATCHing the claude.ai project.
The optimistic pin update patches the host project record instead of the claude.ai project list queries.
The starred-spaces store is the host projects page context (its pinned local projects); nothing is persisted per space.
The gated header slot (cai_calm_dusk gated import) renders nothing: no gated imports are served to this host.
Raven eligibility (/api/account/raven_eligible) is false without an account, so the Share upsell button is hidden.
The cowork space menu is not rendered: the header renders it only for a space.
The deferred-body project context menu is unreachable: the header passes no deferMenuBody.
The deferred-body project dropdown is unreachable: the header passes no deferMenuBody.

The project menu keeps the official Edit details item and adds the host Project instructions and Open folder items; Report, Archive and Delete (claude.ai project APIs) and the official dialogs are not offered.
Local projects are always editable (hasSettingsEditPermission true); there is no org permission query.
The header Pin button toggles the local project's isStarred (local-projects update) instead of the claude.ai project PATCH with its optimistic list update.
